about: Irregularities found by session arena/22be6967 while researching and reviewing (2026-10-15). Each item is published on hotspawn/flagged.html with its evidence. Status: open = still true at the last check; handled = this board works around it.

items.title: Primary landing board left 5 open matches without a pick
items.detail: Before this session the landing page sent visitors to executive/picks.html, whose 08:53 UTC snapshot had 12 picks for 17 open fixtures. 9z vs Falcons was left blank because Pinnacle lists 11:30 UTC while Hotspawn lists 11:00 UTC; HLTV (match 2399409) and Polymarket (gameStartTime 11:00 UTC) both confirm 11:00. This board joins on both teams plus a <= 6 h kickoff window and flags the gap instead of dropping the price.

items.title: Pinnacle kickoff differs from Hotspawn, HLTV and Polymarket (9z vs Falcons)
items.detail: Pinnacle's CS2 matchup lists 2026-10-15 11:30 UTC; the three other sources list 11:00 UTC. Hotspawn's lock (10:54 UTC) follows its own 11:00 start.

items.title: Valve's latest standings list a five that no longer plays (PARIVISION)
items.detail: Valve's 2026-10-05 file lists PARIVISION as FL1T, Jame, slaxejezzz, xiELO, zweih, but HLTV reports HObbit replaced slaxejezzz on 17 Sep 2026. Our own line for PARIVISION therefore describes the old five; it is excluded from the leaderboard consensus whenever a market exists.

items.title: HLTV betting-analytics page shows placeholder prices
items.detail: The static HLTV analytics page for Voca vs Phantom shows '1.23' for every handicap line and bookmaker (eOddset, Betway). Those numbers are not used; only the page's factual notes (ranks, stand-in) are cited.

items.title: Hotspawn still lists 60 fixtures whose lock passed long ago
items.detail: The TransferState payload keeps June 2026 fixtures with status 'scheduled'. They are not pickable; this board lists them only in the full inventory (all.html) as stale listings.

items.title: Rendered Hotspawn times depend on the reader's timezone
items.detail: During research, one read of the lobby rendered times in UTC-4 and a cached second chunk (about 31 minutes older) rendered them in UTC. All times on this site come from the epoch-millisecond fields in the page's ng-state payload, never from rendered text.

items.title: Team names differ across sources
items.detail: Hotspawn WROTBERRY = HLTV/Pinnacle/Valve WBT; RoundsGG = ROUNDS; BetBoom = Pinnacle 'BB Team'; PARIVISION = Pinnacle 'PVISION'; Falcons = Polymarket 'Team Falcons'. Each alias is proven by fixture slot and listed with evidence.

items.title: User premise check: Aurora's roster change is real but not recent-days
items.detail: Verified on HLTV: Jimpphat joined 3 Jul 2026 and kyxsan (new in-game leader) 8 Jul 2026. That is about 3 months before TWC; the new five had 62 HLTV maps and finished 3rd at EPL S24 days earlier. It is treated as a moderate (not strong) onboarding factor.

items.title: Day-1 crowd shares were captured before lock, not at lock
items.detail: The 5%/95% (9z/Aurora) and other day-1 crowd shares come from a capture hours before lock; Hotspawn removes fixtures from the payload after lock, so the final share is not available.

items.title: EGamersWorld page for mellren vs Privateer is internally inconsistent
items.detail: The page states 14:00 and 10:00 for the same match and shows only one side's price (mellren 1.8). Not used; the series length for this fixture stays blank.

items.title: Our own line and the market disagree on two TWC favourites
items.detail: Legacy vs FURIA: market FURIA 58%, our line Legacy 57%. PARIVISION vs BetBoom: market PARIVISION 53%, our line BetBoom 62% (but see IR-03). The pick follows the market; the disagreement is shown on the card and drives the leaderboard play.

items.title: Leaderboard rule was revised after grading day 1 (in-sample)
items.detail: Rule v1 (market only; weak factors counted) would have gone 1/4 on TWC day 1. Rule v2 (consensus of market and our line; only strong/moderate factors) goes 4/4 on the same four matches, which is in-sample and not evidence of skill. Grading of every frozen pre-lock play since launch is published on the strategy page.
